name: Zhejiang Southeast Space Frame Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Southeast Space Frame Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and installs structural and residential steel structures in China and internationally. The company offers space steel structure, light and heavy steel structure, and polyester filament. It also researches, develops, produces, and sells chemical fiber products. In addition, the company engages in photovoltaic power generation in public buildings, industrial and commercial plants, and energy storage; bulk commodity supply chain operations; and construction business. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
